introduction.title: From the terminal to the web.
paragraphs: AWSD Deploy CLI is a Go-based command-line tool for deploying single-page applications to Amazon S3 and serving them through CloudFront.

solution.title: The solution
paragraphs: The tool brings single-page application deployment into a terminal workflow, connecting S3 hosting with CloudFront delivery. It focuses on deployment tooling rather than adding another application interface.

capabilities.title: Terminal-first deployment
capabilities.description: Deploy single-page applications through a command-line workflow.

capabilities.title: S3 hosting
capabilities.description: Use Amazon S3 as the destination for application assets.

capabilities.title: CloudFront delivery
capabilities.description: Serve the deployed application through Amazon CloudFront.
